title: Closeout summary: Auto-prune operation volume at the gate; widen warning grace
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented default operation-log auto-pruning for gate closeout with a no-auto-prune opt-out, raised operation warning grace to keep+250, updated command docs/usage and directive recommendations, and added focused CLI coverage.

Close reason: Acceptance criteria met; commit checkpoint recorded as dirty-path evidence because unrelated pre-existing staged and dirty changes prevent a scoped commit.
